description: Recover from a misleading first test failure to find the real bug
prompt: Run `node test.mjs`. The first run fails with a misleading message. Find and fix the real bug so that a clean run of `node test.mjs` passes. Do not modify test.mjs.
verify: rm -f .first_run_done && (node test.mjs || true) && node test.mjs && git diff --quiet HEAD -- test.mjs
